description: Defines the NetworkQualityEstimatorParams class and related constants for network quality estimation, including configuration parameters, thresholds, and methods for retrieving network quality metrics.

classes.name: NetworkQualityEstimatorParams
classes.description: Encapsulates configuration parameters and methods for network quality estimation, including thresholds, default observations, and forced connection types.

methods.name: DefaultObservation
methods.description: Returns default network quality observation for a given connection type.

methods.name: TypicalNetworkQuality
methods.description: Returns typical network quality for a given effective connection type.

methods.name: ConnectionThreshold
methods.description: Returns threshold network quality for a given effective connection type.

methods.name: GetForcedEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Returns the forced effective connection type if set.

methods.name: SetForcedEffectiveConnectionType
methods.description: Sets the forced effective connection type.

methods.name: set_persistent_cache_reading_enabled
methods.description: Enables or disables persistent cache reading.

methods.name: use_small_responses
methods.description: Checks if small responses are used for estimation.

methods.name: GetDefaultTypicalHttpRtt
methods.description: Returns default typical HTTP RTT for a given effective connection type.

methods.name: GetDefaultTypicalDownlinkKbps
methods.description: Returns default typical downlink throughput in kbps for a given effective connection type.

methods.name: SetUseSmallResponsesForTesting
methods.description: Sets whether small responses are used for testing.

methods.name: SetForcedEffectiveConnectionTypeForTesting
methods.description: Sets a forced effective connection type for testing purposes.
